extracted.name: Pineapple Jerk Wings
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup your favorite Buffalo wing sauce (I like sweet baby rays)
Chopped green onions and cilantro for garnish
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 400 F. Mix all spices and sprinkle on the front and back of chicken. Drizzle chicken with olive oil and rub seasoning mix into chicken. Place chicken on foiled lined pan and bake for 40 mins or until juices run clear.
Mix all ingredients for sauce in a pot over medium heat. Bring to a boil and then simmer for 15 mins. Add chopped green onions.
Remove chicken from pan and toss in sauce. Top with chopped green onions and fresh cilantro.
